speaker: 玛拉
textZh: 林恩，你也感觉到了吧？刚才那下不是货轮靠泊，是滨海变电站主母线的共振。
textEn: Lin, did you feel that? That wasn't a freighter docking—that was the coastal substation busbar resonating.

speaker: 沃德
textZh: 刚接到报告，四号泊位全区失联。先别对外发布警报，你们俩立刻下港核实情况。
textEn: Berth 4 just went completely dark. Hold public alerts for now—head down to the harbor and verify.

speaker: 哈里斯
textZh: 别再查线路短路了！三年前我就警告过他们——盐线东岸的海底软土层正在下沉。
textEn: Stop chasing short circuits! Three years ago I warned them the East Shore seabed clay was subsiding.

speaker: 玛拉
textZh: 整座泊位都在往东海倾斜！先撤回城区主干道，必须立刻通知交通和铁路系统停运！
textEn: The entire berth is tilting toward the East Sea! Pull back to the avenue and halt rail transit now!

speaker: 林婉
textZh: 谢谢你们把药箱送过来！西区还有一列满载通勤市民的早班列车卡在断裂带里，陈主管正急着找支援。
textEn: Thank you for the medical supplies! A commuter train is trapped along the West Rail fault line—Chen needs backup.

speaker: 陈明
textZh: 林恩对吧？快把车开到西区编组站，高架桥下那段路基已经开始错位了！
textEn: Lin, right? Drive over to West Rail Yard fast—the trackbed under the overpass is already shifting!

speaker: 陈明
textZh: 好险！要不是你及时切开北岔道，那节失控平板车就直接撞进站台了。
textEn: Close call! If you hadn't thrown the north switch in time, that runaway flatbed would've hit the platform.

speaker: 哈里斯
textZh: 乘客都安全了，但城市主电缆廊就在我们脚下十五米深的地方——如果不下去手动分流，整座城今晚就会彻底停水停电。
textEn: The passengers are safe, but the main utility corridor runs fifteen meters below us—we must reroute power manually.

speaker: 玛拉
textZh: 灯亮起来了……天哪，林恩你看那堵承重墙！三年前的加固工程根本没浇筑到位，有人偷换了标号！
textEn: Lights are back—wait, Lin, look at that retaining wall! The reinforcement concrete was downgraded three years ago!

speaker: 哈里斯
textZh: 不止如此——主排水泵站的数据线被人为切成了离线状态，南港船坞此刻正在倒灌海水！
textEn: Worse—the main drainage pump telemetry was deliberately cut offline. South Drydock is flooding right now!

speaker: 玛拉
textZh: 水位稳住了！再晚三十秒，整个南港工业区就会被海水倒灌！
textEn: Water level is holding! Thirty seconds later and the whole South Industrial District would've flooded!

speaker: 林婉
textZh: 所有工人都救上来了。但全城通信塔全部掉线，如果不翻过西山恢复高地主中继，外面根本不知道盐线发生了什么！
textEn: Every worker is safe, but city comms are dead. We must climb the West Highlands to restore the ridge relay!

speaker: 陈明
textZh: 从山顶往下看才真切感受到——半座盐线市都黑了，只有医院和码头还亮着几盏应急灯。
textEn: Looking down from the ridge, it really hits you—half of Saltline is dark except the hospital and docks.

speaker: 玛拉
textZh: 山脊中继通电了！现在进主通信中心大厅，沃德和外海平台的求救频道都在等着接通。
textEn: Ridge relay is live! Head into the main comms hall—Ward and the offshore platform distress line are waiting.

speaker: 沃德
textZh: 林恩，你想清楚——现在把未核实的沉降报告直接广播给全城，会立刻引发恐慌，也可能拖慢外海平台的救援调度。
textEn: Think carefully, Lin. Broadcasting unverified subsidence data now could spark panic and delay the offshore rescue.

speaker: 林恩
textZh: 人们有权知道脚下的土地正在发生什么，但外海平台上的十七个人也等不了。这是我的决定。
textEn: People have a right to know what's happening beneath their feet, and those seventeen offshore can't wait. This is my call.

speaker: 林婉
textZh: 风力超过十级了！灯塔终于重新亮起来了，救援艇能看清外海航道了！
textEn: Winds are past Force 10! The lighthouse is finally lit—the rescue boat can see the channel now!

speaker: 林恩
textZh: 抓稳扶手——外海平台就在前方三海里，我们绝不把任何一个人留在海上。
textEn: Hold onto the rail—the offshore platform is three nautical miles ahead. Nobody gets left behind.

speaker: 林婉
textZh: 十六、十七——外海平台全部十七名技术员一个不少，全部安全登艇！
textEn: Sixteen, seventeen—all seventeen offshore engineers are accounted for and safely aboard!

speaker: 玛拉
textZh: 但你看平台刚才传回的最后一组海底传感器数据：沉降已经把海底高压电缆拉断了，整座盐线城区此刻陷入彻底黑暗！
textEn: Look at the last subsea sensor packet: subsidence snapped the main sea cable—downtown Saltline is completely blacked out!

speaker: 沃德
textZh: 外海平台十七个人都活着回来了……林恩，我承认我低估了你们。市政档案中心的权限密钥给你，去把整件事的根子查清楚。
textEn: All seventeen came back alive... Lin, I underestimated you. Take the Civic Archive key and uncover the full truth.

speaker: 林恩
textZh: 灯已经重新亮起来了。明天太阳升起之前，我们要给整座城市一个交代。
textEn: The lights are coming back on. Before sunrise, we're giving this whole city the answers it deserves.

speaker: 哈里斯
textZh: 当年是我软弱签了延期维修。今天这份实测数据加上外海传感记录，谁也再压不住了。
textEn: I was weak to sign that deferral years ago. With these readings and the offshore logs, nobody can bury it now.

speaker: 沃德
textZh: 账可以天亮后再算——现在南港主防潮闸和机场应急供电同时出现临界警报，全队按方案分头行动！
textEn: We settle accounts at dawn—South Tide Gate and the airfield grid just hit critical alarm. Move to your stations!

speaker: 玛拉
textZh: 主并网同步率 100%！全城防潮闸、医院、铁路和港口电网全部恢复稳定！
textEn: Grid synchronization at 100%! Tide gates, hospitals, rail lines, and harbor power are all stable!

speaker: 沃德
textZh: 风暴云层正在散开……全体应急队员，干得漂亮。盐线市挺过来了。
textEn: The storm clouds are breaking... Outstanding work, everyone. Saltline made it through.

speaker: 玛拉
textZh: 听见港口的汽笛声了吗？四号泊位刚才重新开航了，这次每一处地基传感器都连在公开监测网上。
textEn: Hear the harbor horns? Berth 4 just reopened—and this time every seabed sensor feeds the public grid.

speaker: 林恩
textZh: 从第一个停电的早晨走到今天，谢谢你们每一个人。欢迎回到新的盐线市。
textEn: From that first blackout morning to today—thank you all. Welcome back to a new Saltline.

speaker: 队友
textZh: 收到！马上跟紧你，注意前方路况。
textEn: Copy! Moving in right behind you.

speaker: 队友
textZh: 明白，我先过去检查控制台，你掩护我！
textEn: On it—heading to the objective console now!

speaker: 队友
textZh: 原地警戒待命，有情况随时呼叫我。
textEn: Holding position here—call when you need me.

speaker: 队友
textZh: 收到，我去周边巡逻侦察，发现异常立刻电台回报。
textEn: Patrolling the perimeter—I'll radio if I spot anything.

speaker: 队友
textZh: 电台信号正常！目标控制台就在我指向的方向，走吧！
textEn: Radio clear! The objective console is right where I'm pointing—let's move!
